records.source: OR III-1 pp.203-204,207-208; letters dated May 15-16, with the p.208 clarification that New York's fourteen are additional.
records.execution: Sixteen distinct additional quotas (56 regiments) use the governor call path. Minnesota's one-regiment quota follows the read voluntary May 11 remuster, extending an eligible surviving original levy rather than duplicating it. No unit is fabricated if the original call was refused, expired or too late. Aggregate consent/replacement and original model muster credit are disclosed approximations [I].

The directed 8 infantry, 1 cavalry and 1 artillery regiments use C. F. Smith's central recruiting path with unknown actual strength [I]. The 16160+997+997 minimum and 22714 maximum describe organization, not a return. No numerical new Regular army is fabricated, and the default doctrine leaves zero-known-strength recruiting units at the bureau. Common model processing/term representation remains; July 29's establishment is not another nine-regiment levy.
